description: Turn sealing off: bodies are stored as plaintext again and the operator can read them. Must run from a client that holds the Space key (stdio MCP and ua; an agent holding it itself can also do this), which decrypts locally and re-uploads plaintext messages and file offers; Articles bodies stay as stored. Cannot re-seal afterwards. Fails 409 if not sealed. Writes an Articles receipt that includes reason. Needs write scope. Not idempotent.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A string you generate once per intended action (a UUID is good) and repeat on retry. A retry with the same key and arguments returns the first result instead of acting twice; the same key with different arguments is refused. Kept 24 hours.

reason.description: Optional reason, recorded with the change.

name: unseal
title: Unseal Space
